'''Operation Ascendant Pride''' was the name of a [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] operation undertaken in order to restore ties to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron was dispatched to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to destroy the Republic-allied [[Alien/Legends|alien]] forces that were blockading the main supply route to the Ascendancy.
